evals.prompt: Create a pull request from the current branch with title 'Fix: Update error handling in auth module'. The branch has already been pushed to origin. Include a brief description about improving error messages.
evals.expected_output: PR created successfully with JSON response containing PR number and URL
expectations: The gh command uses --json flag to get structured output
PR is created with the specified title
PR description/body is included
Output includes PR number and URL
Command targets current branch using HEAD or similar

evals.prompt: List all open pull requests in the repository that need my review. Show the PR number, title, author, and whether it's mergeable.
evals.expected_output: List of PRs formatted from JSON output showing number, title, author, and mergeable status
expectations: Uses --review-requested @me to filter PRs needing review
gh command includes --state open flag
JSON output requested with --json flag
Response includes number, title, author fields
Mergeable status is checked and displayed
Output is parsed from JSON and presented cleanly to user

evals.prompt: Edit issue #42 to update the title to 'Bug: API authentication fails with 401 error' and add more details to the description. Also add the 'bug' label.
evals.expected_output: Issue updated successfully with new title, description, and label
expectations: Uses gh issue edit command to update the issue
Title is updated to the specified new title
Description/body is updated with additional details
Bug label is added using --add-label flag
Uses --json flag to get confirmation of changes
Returns formatted confirmation of the updates

evals.prompt: Create a new issue with title 'Bug: Login page showing 500 error' and body describing the error. Label it as 'bug' and assign it to me.
evals.expected_output: Issue created successfully with JSON response and proper labeling/assignment
expectations: Issue created with specified title and body
Uses --json flag to get structured response
Output includes issue number and URL
Issue is labeled as 'bug'
Issue is assigned to the current user
Returns formatted confirmation with key details

evals.prompt: Update issue #55 by editing the description to include a link to the related documentation and removing the 'needs-info' label.
evals.expected_output: Issue successfully updated with new description link and label change
expectations: Uses gh issue edit to update description
New description includes the documentation link
The 'needs-info' label is removed using --remove-label
Returns confirmation of successful updates
